method: Separate curl connection per request, 0.5 second gaps. after_connection_ms = 1000 * (time_starttransfer - time_pretransfer). First means observed handler count 1 on a generated instance ID. Platform timings joined by cf-ray.
scope: Isolated workers.dev probes, no production routes, application secrets, database, Durable Object bindings, or scheduled tasks. Existing docs content R2 bucket was bound for read probes and cached docs rendering.

controls.tiny: Same probe, but entire site module upload present and never imported
controls.full: Static import of actual application, same probe plus real docs
controls.data: JS bytes concatenated as one inert Data module; no actual site JS or WASM modules
controls.no-wasm: All site JavaScript retained, original compiled OG WASM replaced by empty valid WASM for diagnostic noop calls only
controls.single-js: JS bytes encoded as inert exported string in one module
controls.many-js: Same string data distributed over 1000 exported-string modules
controls.monolith: Actual app rebundled by esbuild into one JS app module, retaining original WASM, plus probe entry

important_limits: First observed invocation is not proof of a platform code-cache miss.
Synthetic controls isolate factors but timings are not additive and were not randomized.
Non-200 platform responses are retained and excluded from latency summaries.
No-wasm control cannot render OG images and is not an application fix.
Monolithic rebundle was diagnostic only and was not deployed to production.
Reported startup validation time and invocation CPU/wall do not cover all observed pre-handler delay.
Native trace query API returned 403 with available credentials. Production native tracing was disabled; probe tracing was enabled.
Remote production profile succeeded but contained only root/idle samples, so it does not attribute cold loading.
